pattern: I HAVE TRAINED FOR THIS IN MY MOTHER'S GARAGE.
MY SENSEI IS A VIDEO TAPE. IT IS VERY WISE.
PREPARE YOURSELF. I AM ABOUT TO SAY SOMETHING DEEP.
THE BLADE IS FOAM. THE INTENT IS REAL.
BEHOLD MY STANCE. IT TOOK ME NINE YEARS AND ONE HIP.
HAVE YOU READ MY CERTIFICATE? IT IS LAMINATED.
I AM LEGALLY A SAMURAI. MY MOM SIGNED THE FORM.
THIS TRAIN IS MY DOJO. THE CONDUCTOR HATES IT.
I HAVE NOT BATHED SINCE I BEGAN MY TRAINING. FOR FOCUS.
SILENCE. I AM CHANNELING MY INNER WARRIOR. HE IS LATE.
MY WAIFU PILLOW BELIEVES IN ME.
I HAVE SEEN EVERY SAMURAI MOVIE. TWICE. ON MUTE.
MY BLADE HUNGERS. MY STOMACH ALSO HUNGERS. I SKIPPED LUNCH.
I HAVE NEVER KISSED ANYONE. I HAVE KISSED MY SWORD. IT WAS FOAM.
hurt: THAT IS NOT IN THE MANUAL
MY HONOR! IT WAS PENDING!
THAT WAS DISHONORABLE. AND EFFECTIVE.
MY HAKAMA HAS RIPPED. MY MOM SEWED THIS.
NOT THE CERTIFICATE! IT IS LAMINATED BUT NOT THAT LAMINATED!
OW! I AM BRUISED AND I BRUISE LIKE A PEACH!
MY FOAM SWORD IS BENDING. MY SPIRIT IS BENDING.
MY HEADBAND SLIPPED. I CANNOT SEE. I CANNOT FOCUS.
STOP! THE TRAIN IS MOVING AND I AM MOTION SICK!
I THINK I PULLED MY NINJA MUSCLE. I MEAN SAMURAI. I MEAN GROIN.
MY KNEES CRACK LIKE A BOWL OF CEREAL.
THE MANUAL SAID YOU WOULD BOW FIRST!
THAT WAS A CHEAP SHOT. I WILL WRITE IT IN MY BLOG.
MY GLASSES! I DO NOT WEAR GLASSES IN BATTLE. THAT IS WHY I MISSED.
OW! MY STANCE! YOU BROKE MY STANCE!
I HAVE A LOW PAIN TOLERANCE AND A HIGH OPINION OF MYSELF.
THE CONDUCTOR IS WATCHING. THIS IS SO EMBARRASSING.
YOU HAVE STRUCK MY POINTS OF WEAKNESS. ALL OF THEM.
MY HONOR IS DAMAGED. MY RENTAL ARMOR IS ALSO DAMAGED.
I CAN TASTE FOAM. AND BLOOD. MOSTLY FOAM.
defeat: I HAVE MISSED MY STOP. AND MY DESTINY.
TELL MY MOTHER... I WILL BE HOME FOR DINNER...
THE MANUAL NEVER COVERED A FAMILY.
I MUST COMMIT TO A LONG NAP.
I AM NO LONGER LEGALLY A SAMURAI. I AM LEGALLY A KEVIN.
MY BLOG READERS WILL NEVER KNOW.
I SHALL MEDITATE ON THIS DEFEAT. IN MY ROOM. WITH THE DOOR LOCKED.
THE TRAIN DOORS ARE CLOSING. SO ARE MY EYES.
I BOW TO YOU. I ALSO FALL TO YOU.
I WANT A REFUND ON MY SAMURAI CLASSES.
card: I AM LEGALLY A SAMURAI. I HAVE THE CERTIFICATE.
I HAVE TWO SWORDS. BOTH FOAM. BOTH DEADLY. TO MY EGO.
I TRAINED FOR TWELVE YEARS ON A BEANBAG CHAIR.
MY HONOR IS PENDING. MY RAGE IS APPROVED.
THIS TRAIN IS MINE UNTIL THE NEXT STOP.
I SPEAK SEVEN WORDS OF JAPANESE. YOU WILL HEAR NONE OF THEM.
I HAVE NOT LOST A SINGLE FIGHT. I HAVE NOT HAD A SINGLE FIGHT.
MY MOTHER IRONED MY ROBES. DO NOT GET BLOOD ON THEM.
YOU STAND IN THE PRESENCE OF A BLACK BELT. I BOUGHT IT ONLINE.
MY BLADE IS SHARP. MY BLADE IS FOAM. THESE ARE BOTH TRUE.
I HAVE A SWORD THAT LIGHTS UP. I LEFT IT AT HOME. IT NEEDS BATTERIES.
PREPARE TO BE SMACKED WITH GREAT DISCIPLINE.
phase: KEVIN UNSHEATHES THE SECOND FOAM SWORD
KEVIN TIES HIS HEADBAND TIGHTER. IT HURTS.
KEVIN ENTERS HIS SERIOUS MODE. IT IS THE SAME AS HIS NORMAL MODE.
KEVIN REMOVES HIS JACKET. HE HAS A TANK TOP WITH A DRAGON ON IT.
KEVIN SCREAMS FOR A VERY LONG TIME
KEVIN HAS STOPPED HOLDING BACK. HE WAS NOT HOLDING BACK.
THE TRAIN LURCHES. KEVIN LURCHES HARDER.
KEVIN CALLS UPON THE SPIRITS OF HIS ANCESTORS. THEY DO NOT PICK UP.
KEVIN CRACKS HIS KNUCKLES. ONE OF THEM DOES NOT UNCRACK.
KEVIN TAKES A HIT OF HIS INHALER
KEVIN SAYS SOMETHING DEEP. NOBODY HEARS IT OVER THE TRAIN.
defeatBanner: KEVIN IS NO LONGER LEGALLY A SAMURAI.
THE CONDUCTOR ESCORTS KEVIN OFF THE TRAIN.
KEVIN GETS OFF AT THE WRONG STATION. AGAIN.
KEVIN HAS BEEN SENT HOME TO HIS MOTHER.
KEVIN IS DEFEATED. HIS BLOG IS UPDATED.
SHAME ON KEVIN. SHAME ON HIS BEANBAG.
THE NEXT STOP IS KEVIN'S DEFEAT. HE IS ALREADY THERE.
